text_block_list.text:
One day, I was talking with Admire Groove 
about nutritional balance in meals.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll make up for what's lacking with 
supplements. All that's left that I need 
is... chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I never said anything about chocolate. As 
if I would want to eat such a thing...

fatigue from the races is catching up to 
her... I may need to reconsider her race 
schedule.
